tenders.summary: Canada’s coasts and oceans are an integral part of the country’s culture, identity, environment, and economy.

tenders.text: w7701-268123 multimodal data exploitation for multi-domain c4isr pwgsc, on behalf of defence research and development canada – valcartier research center, is issuing this solicitation of offer for the acquisition of research and development (r&d) services to develop next-generation c4isr capabilities to enhance situational awareness and decision-making in multi-domain military operations (land, air, maritime, space, cyber, and information domains). the work will address the integration and exploitation of data from diverse sources using artificial intelligence, machine learning, and multimodal data fusion. activities will include the development of c4isr conceptual frameworks, the creation of data integration, analysis, and visualization tools, research into ai-based sensor fusion, the adaptation of analytical capabilities for multi-domain operations, and the assessment of emerging technologies to address future operational requirements. the r&d services are located in québec, canada, as detailed in annex a.

tenders.summary: NOTICE OF PROPOSED PROCUREMENT The Department of National Defence (DND), through the Strategic Medical Countermeasures Program (SMCP) on behalf of the Canadian Forces Health Services Group (CF H Svcs Gp), has a requirement for the supply of Calcium Trisodium…
tenders.text: calcium trisodium pentetate (ca-dtpa) ampoules notice of proposed procurement the department of national defence (dnd), through the strategic medical countermeasures program (smcp) on behalf of the canadian forces health services group (cf h svcs gp), has a requirement for the supply of calcium trisodium pentetate (ca-dtpa) ampoules for the treatment of canadian armed forces (caf) personnel who may have been exposed to radioactive contamination involving transuranic elements. the ca-dtpa product must consist of sterile calcium trisodium pentetate solution for injection, containing approximately 1,000 mg to 1,055 mg of active ingredient in a 5 ml ampoule suitable for intravenous administration. the product is intended for use as a medical countermeasure to enhance the elimination of internally deposited radioactive transuranic elements, including plutonium, americium and curium, following confirmed or suspected radiological exposure. the product must meet all applicable regulatory, quality assurance, packaging, labelling and shelf-life requirements specified in the solicitation documents. the initial requirement consists of the supply of 250 ca-dtpa ampoules for delivery no later than 1 march 2027. the resulting contract is anticipated to be valid from contract award date to 31 march 2031 and includes additional scheduled deliveries of 250 ampoules in fiscal year 2027-2028 and 250 ampoules in fiscal year 2028-2029. the contract will also include an option for up to an additional 500 ampoules exercisable during the contract

tenders.summary: NRC Herzberg Astronomy and Astrophysics (HAA) requires extended measurement capabilities in the millimetre-wave frequency range to support ongoing research in characterizing front-end components for low-noise receivers in radio astronomy.
tenders.text: purchase of two (2) millimetre-wave frequency extender modules for a vector network analyzers (vnas) from 110 ghz to 170 ghz nrc herzberg astronomy and astrophysics (haa) requires extended measurement capabilities in the millimetre-wave frequency range to support ongoing research in characterizing front-end components for low-noise receivers in radio astronomy. existing vector network analyzers (vnas) at nrc haa are currently limited to a maximum operational frequency of 116 ghz. to increase its measurement capability, nrc haa intends to acquire frequency extender modules covering the 110–170 ghz band. these extenders must integrate with either of haa's existing analysers (keysight pna n5227b and rohde & schwarz zna67), providing high dynamic range and stable two-port measurements.

tenders.summary: Background Canadian Wildlife Service (CWS) Ontario manages 10 National Wildlife Areas in Ontario.
tenders.text: develop wayfinding strategy for mississippi lake national wildlife area (mlnwa), st clair national wildlife area (scnwa) and big creek national wildlife area (bcnwa) background canadian wildlife service (cws) ontario manages 10 national wildlife areas in ontario. two of these, prince edward point national wildlife area (pepnwa) and big creek national wildlife area (bcnwa) have also been designated as connecting canadians to nature sites. out of more than 60 national wildlife areas across the country only 10 have been designated as connecting canadians to nature sites. these 10 sites as well as select few of the other nwas are open to the public and provide opportunities for people to experience and connect with nature. cws ontario is working to improve accessibility and enhance visitors’ experiences at publicly accessible nwas in ontario. in 2025, a wayfinding strategy and upgrades to signage were completed at pepnwa to improve accessibility for visitors. cws ontario is now looking to implement similar improvements at other publicly accessible nwas in the province using guidance developed for pepnwa. objective develop wayfinding strategy for mississippi lake national wildlife area (mlnwa), st clair national wildlife area (scnwa) and big creek national wildlife area (bcnwa) and complete signage designs as required based on outcomes of individual site visits and using guidance outlined in design brief (appendix b) and wayfinding signage design intent (appendix c) previously prepared for pepnwa.

tenders.title: Mapping Canada's Advanced Manufacturing Capabilities
tenders.summary: The Department of Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED) is seeking professional services to conduct a comprehensive assessment and mapping of Canada's advanced manufacturing ecosystem.
tenders.text: mapping canada's advanced manufacturing capabilities the department of innovation, science and economic development canada (ised) is seeking professional services to conduct a comprehensive assessment and mapping of canada's advanced manufacturing ecosystem. the work involves identifying and analyzing canadian capabilities, assets, firms, research institutions, industry associations, government programs, and test facilities across five technology domains: robotics and automation, additive manufacturing, smart factories and digitally enabled production systems, advanced materials and composites manufacturing, and advanced tooling and precision manufacturing. the contractor will assess canada's strengths, weaknesses, gaps, sovereign capabilities, and national security considerations; benchmark canadian capabilities against leading international jurisdictions; estimate market opportunities and investment requirements; and provide strategic recommendations to support future policy development, investment prioritization, workforce development, and ecosystem coordination. deliverables include a draft report, a comprehensive final report, supporting annexes and data sources, and a presentation deck.

tenders.text: canadian lunar microreactor systems the canadian space agency (csa) is seeking information from canadian industry, academia, research institutions, utilities, and other interested stakeholders on canadian technologies and capabilities relevant to lunar microreactors and enabling technologies. the purpose of this request for information (rfi) is to obtain a broad, evidence-based view of canada's existing strengths, technology maturity, facilities, supply chains, partnerships and development pathways. respondents may address a complete system, one or more subsystems, specialized research or testing capabilities, or a potential consortium role. canada is not assuming that a single canadian entity would design and deliver an end-to-end lunar microreactor system. this rfi is intended to gather information only and does not constitute a solicitation, funding opportunity, or commitment by the government of canada. information received may inform future csa space exploration programs, technology development, technology demonstrations, procurement strategies, and international collaborations related to lunar surface power systems.

tenders.title: Wharf Reconstruction Phase II – Port au Choix, NL
tenders.summary: 1. TITLE Wharf Reconstruction – Port au Choix, NL for Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) 2.
tenders.text: wharf reconstruction phase ii – port au choix, nl 1. title wharf reconstruction – port au choix, nl for fisheries and oceans canada (dfo) 2. scope of work the work covered consists of the furnishing of all plant, labour, equipment and material for the reconstruction of approximately 73.2 meters of the marginal wharf at port au choix, nl in accordance with specifications and accompanying drawings and subject to all terms and conditions of the contract. in general, the work under this contract consists of, but will not necessarily be limited to, the following: • site work including mobilization, demobilization, excavation, partial demolition and removal of existing crib work, hauling, and disposal offsite and onsite. • required survey to set location of new work as indicated on the drawings. • dredging of overburden sediments from the harbour bottom to reach bedrock in the footprint of the rock mattress to be placed for the crib work. • construction of timber cribwork on a placed rock mattress with associated rock ballast, fendering, wheelguard and blocking, type “a” cleats and blocks, and ladders. • electrical work as required and detailed for the provision of street lights, shore power pedestals and the installation of a new 600 amp single phase electrical service. • supply and placement of new quarried rock fill and class “a” and class “b” granular material. • supply and placement of new asphalt pavement. • supply and placement of scour protection. • construction of reinforced concrete wharf deck and upland slab on grade. •

tenders.summary: The Department of Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada has a requirement for strategic foresight research and analysis to assess the impacts of emerging geopolitical, economic and technological developments on Canada's industrial…
tenders.text: strategic foresight – canada's industrial resilience the department of innovation, science and economic development canada has a requirement for strategic foresight research and analysis to assess the impacts of emerging geopolitical, economic and technological developments on canada's industrial competitiveness, manufacturing resilience and digital opportunities. the work will include developing and analyzing 12 to 16 potential future scenarios across four strategic contexts, examining their potential implications for canada's industrial economy, supply chain resilience, trade relationships, technology ecosystems and government investment decisions. the contractor will be required to facilitate working sessions and workshops with ised representatives and senior management, prepare analytical materials, and deliver comprehensive foresight reports outlining key risks, opportunities, policy and investment considerations, and recommendations to support canada's industrial policy and investment planning.

tenders.title: inversion of the electric field streaming otential-controlled source electromagnetic (spCSEM) data acquired at the Aquistore site
tenders.summary: The objective of this work is to perform an inversion of the electric field spCSEM data acquired at the Aquistore site.
tenders.text: inversion of the electric field streaming otential-controlled source electromagnetic (spcsem) data acquired at the aquistore site the objective of this work is to perform an inversion of the electric field spcsem data acquired at the aquistore site. an equivalent point-source sp inversion of the electrical related data should be performed to estimate a) fluid injection intensity (source strength), b) pore pressure gradient around the injection point, c) pressure propagation away from the injector, and d) changes in pressure-driven flow behavior through time. nrcan expects that the contractor uses the calculated pressure gradients to reconstruct plume boundaries (subject to additional information).

tenders.title: Web-based Platform for Whole Building Life Cycle Analysis (WBLCA) and Embodied Carbon emissions in building and infrastructure construction
tenders.summary: The National Research Council on behalf of the Government of Canada (GoC) and its’ Partners seek to procure a secure, scalable, bilingual web-based digital platform (“the platform”) to support the reporting, review, analysis, and visualization of embodied…
tenders.text: web-based platform for whole building life cycle analysis (wblca) and embodied carbon emissions in building and infrastructure construction the national research council on behalf of the government of canada (goc) and its’ partners seek to procure a secure, scalable, bilingual web-based digital platform (“the platform”) to support the reporting, review, analysis, and visualization of embodied carbon emissions in building and infrastructure construction projects. this procurement includes the design, development, configuration, deployment and ongoing support of the platform. the solution will provide a centralized system that ensure consistent data collection, automated validation, and reporting in alignment with embodied carbon disclosure and reduction policies for buildings and infrastructure projects. at a minimum, the platform shall enable: - intake of material and project specific embodied carbon submissions; - import and export capabilities for compatible whole building life cycle assessment (wblca) submission reports and raw data; - dashboards and customizable reporting functions for internal analysis; and - the creation of an anonymized public dataset. the platform must comply with government of canada security requirements for protected a information and meet canadian-based data residency requirements.

tenders.title: Temperature Cycling Chambers
tenders.summary: The National Research Council of Canada (NRC) requires the procurement of temperature cycling chambers to support the thermal evaluation of advanced energy storage technologies.
tenders.text: temperature cycling chambers the national research council of canada (nrc) requires the procurement of temperature cycling chambers to support the thermal evaluation of advanced energy storage technologies. as lithium-ion battery systems continue to increase in energy density and are deployed across transportation, aerospace, and stationary energy storage applications, controlled temperature testing is essential to understand how these systems perform under a range of environmental conditions. temperature cycling chambers provide a controlled thermal environment in which battery cells, modules, and associated components can be exposed to defined temperature conditions during operation. this capability enables the evaluation of battery performance, reliability, and durability while operating across the temperature ranges encountered in real-world applications. the objective of this procurement is to provide the automotive and surface transportation (ast) team with the capability to conduct controlled temperature testing of battery system and system reliability. the ast team operates a unique canadian facility dedicated to evaluating battery cells and modules well beyond their normal operating envelopes. this procurement will enhance our laboratory infrastructure to meet the rigorous testing demands of the military, aerospace, and light-duty transportation sectors. all deliverables must be received no later than 18 weeks after contract award.

tenders.title: Thermal Conductivity Measurement System
tenders.summary: The National Research Council of Canada (NRC) requires the supply of a state-of-the-art thermophysical analysis system for the direct and simultaneous measurement of thermal conductivity (?), thermal diffusivity (a), and specific heat capacity (cp) for…
tenders.text: thermal conductivity measurement system the national research council of canada (nrc) requires the supply of a state-of-the-art thermophysical analysis system for the direct and simultaneous measurement of thermal conductivity (?), thermal diffusivity (a), and specific heat capacity (cp) for rechargeable battery systems and their constituent materials. the layered architecture of modern batteries introduces strong anisotropic heat transfer, with significant differences between in-plane and through-plane conduction. conventional steady-state measurement techniques are often too slow or imprecise to capture these directional effects within intact cells. the required system must therefore use a transient thermal measurement methodology, such as the transient plane source (tps) or equivalent, to enable non-destructive and direction-resolved characterization of pouch, prismatic, and cylindrical cells. the new instrumentation will expand nrc’s automotive and surface transportation (ast) sector capabilities by enabling precise measurement of both isotropic and anisotropic thermophysical properties under controlled temperature environments, ranging from sub-ambient to elevated conditions representative of real battery operation. these capabilities are essential for developing next-generation testing standards and modeling frameworks that address safety, cooling optimization, and lifecycle management in electric vehicle and stationary energy storage applications.

tenders.text: international commercial trade informtaion subscription service the cbsa is seeking input from industry on the following: specific products offered as an online subscription service that provides access to tools that support the international commercial trade environment (i.e. databases and tools that simplify trade compliance, duty calculations, and tax obligations) with specific access required to the world customs organization (wco) harmonized system (hs) explanatory notes and compendium of classification opinions (official, non-legally binding administrative tools used to interpret and apply the international hs nomenclature). the cbsa intends to use input to help determine the “way forward” as to whether and how this service should be acquired, delivered, and managed and if so, to solidify its procurement approach. the purpose of this request for information (rfi) is to develop a better understanding of the capabilities and maturity of industry with respect to the ability of the private sector to provide goods and/or services to the cbsa.

tenders.buyer: Department of Employment and Social Development (ESDC)
tenders.summary: To support the development of the next phase of regulations, Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC) is launching this RFI to gather information from digital technology vendors and suppliers on their current accessibility-related capabilities…
tenders.text: request for information (rfi) on accessible digital technologies including artificial intelligence systems to support the development of the next phase of regulations, employment and social development canada (esdc) is launching this rfi to gather information from digital technology vendors and suppliers on their current accessibility-related capabilities, practices, implementation challenges, and readiness with respect to artificial intelligence (ai) systems, software, and hardware. the rfi seeks information on: • current accessibility capabilities, policies, and practices relating to software, hardware, and ai systems; • conformance with relevant accessibility standards and specifications for software, hardware, and ai systems; • approaches to incorporating accessibility throughout the product lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and procurement; • barriers, implementation challenges, and considerations associated with achieving accessibility; and, • organizational readiness to meet potential future accessibility requirements. the information collected through this process will help inform the development of the next phase of digital technologies accessibility regulations under the aca.

tenders.text: department of national defence - 2025 freight forwarding transportation source lists 1. background the department of national defence (dnd) moves materiel domestically and internationally on an as required basis to support operations and exercises. dnd accomplishes this task primarily through its own means but also contracts directly with industry for the movement of cargo by freight forwarding for some multi-modal movements. to contract for transportation requirements that arise, dnd maintains multiple source lists of pre-qualified service providers and brokers. 2. source list renewal dnd’s 2022 transportation source lists expire february 18th, 2025. as such, dnd is soliciting industry applications to renew each of these source lists. freight forwarding services a. simple b. complex a separate application is required for each source list. additionally, applicants must include details to support which ever sub-grouping they are applying for, whether simple or complex. 3. validity period dnd’s 2025 freight forwarding transportation source lists will remain valid for a three-year (3) period, beginning february 19th, 2025. during this timeframe any dnd transportation requirements that arise will be issued to the members of the appropriate source list. 4. application process to be included in any one of these 2025 source lists, applicants must address all qualifying criteria in the appropriate application form at section 5. applications submitted by february 14th, 2025 will be reviewed immediately and successful applicants included in the appropriate source list

tenders.text: critical incident vehicles (civs) the government of canada is seeking to establish supply arrangements (sas) to procure: critical incident vehicles (civs) in three (3) different cab chassis configurations single axle 4x2 or 4x4 or tandem 6x4, equipped from a variety of specialized bodies for the rcmp. sas will be awarded to suppliers that meet all technical criteria and can provide all cab chassis and bodies configurations. offerors are encouraged to submit an indigenous participation plan (ipp) at the rfp stage as describe herein. an sa is a non-binding arrangement between canada and a pre-qualified supplier that allows departments and agencies to award contracts and solicit bids from a pool of pre-qualified suppliers for specific requirements within the scope of the sa. an sa is not a contract for the provision of goods and services described in it and neither party is legally bound, as a result of signing a supply arrangement alone. the intent of a supply arrangement is to establish a framework to permit expeditious processing of individual bid solicitations, which result in legally binding contracts for the goods and services described in those bid solicitations.

tenders.title: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada - Interpreter Program
tenders.summary: The Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada (IRB) is Canada's largest independent administrative tribunal. It is responsible for making well-reasoned decisions on immigration and refugee matters, efficiently, fairly and in accordance with the law.
tenders.text: immigration and refugee board of canada - interpreter program the immigration and refugee board of canada (irb) is canada's largest independent administrative tribunal. it is responsible for making well-reasoned decisions on immigration and refugee matters, efficiently, fairly and in accordance with the law. the irb decides, among other responsibilities, who needs refugee protection among the thousands of claimants who come to canada annually. every year, the board renders thousands of decisions on refugee protection and immigration matters. at these hearings, refugees and immigrants who are not fluent in english or french count on the irb to provide them with interpretive services. these interpretive services are required in a wide variety of languages and dialects, reflecting the diverse backgrounds of the refugees and immigrants who come to canada. in order to manage the interpretive services required for such a large number of hearings, including urgent hearings, irb issues contracts to interpreters who provide services on an “as-and-when-requested” basis and invoice for any services they provide. all interpreters are paid the same flat hourly rate. these contracts effectively work as a “roster” of potential interpreters who could be called upon to provide interpretive services at a hearing. selection for contract award: when selecting an applicant for a contract, the irb will consider several factors including the following: • the fluctuation of language demand with respect to immigration trends from specific regions. • previous in

tenders.text: rfsa e60hp-25etrucks-b, electric trucks classes 6, 7 and 8 reissue of request for supply arrangements.this request for supply arrangements (rfsa) cancels and supersedes previous rfsa numbere60hp-22etru dated 2022-05-05 with a closing date of 2028-04-03 at 2:00 pm. the government of canada is seeking to establish supply arrangements (sas) to procure: electric trucks classes 6, 7 and 8 with different body configurations. sas will be awarded to suppliers that meet all technical criteria and can provide the requirement. offerors are encouraged to submit an indigenous participation plan (ipp) at the rfp stage as describe herein. an sa is a non-binding arrangement between canada and a pre-qualified supplier that allows departments and agencies to award contracts and solicit bids from a pool of pre-qualified suppliers for specific requirements within the scope of the sa. an sa is not a contract for the provision of goods and services described in it and neither party is legally bound, as a result of signing a supply arrangement alone. the intent of a supply arrangement is to establish a framework to permit expeditious processing of individual bid solicitations, which result in legally binding contracts for the goods and services described in those bid solicitations.

tenders.text: inmate purchasing plan this is a republication of this notice and not an amendment. access the original notice at https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities/tender-notice/pw-21-00974352. if you are currently subscribed to notifications about this tender, you need to re-subscribe by following this new notice. this is a public notice to advise the supplier community that the correctional service of canada (csc) intends to enter into a business account agreement with a pre-identified supplier for the goods and services described in this notice. csc wishes to allow other suppliers to signal their interest in providing these goods and services, by submitting a statement of capabilities. csc will not be awarding a contract as a result of this notice. csc will be establishing a list of potential suppliers for the required goods and services. if another supplier submits a statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in this notice, on or before the closing date and time stated in this notice, csc will include the supplier in the list of potential suppliers. 1. definition of the requirement: policy on reciprocal procurement: the policy on reciprocal procurement does not apply to this procurement. 1.1 background the correctional service of canada (csc) is the federal government agency responsible for administering court-imposed sentences of a term of two years or more. csc is responsible for managing institutions of various security levels and supervising offenders under conditiona
